_comment: The riddle's build (Riddle/README.md, 'Fitted parts'): its one stage after the frame, the riddle on its bearers, as its rig's parts draw it; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). Two nails and strips of iron, meteoric iron or steel at once, its woven mesh (the riddle's oak boards are the frame recipe's). A hand station: nothing wears. No block: the riddle's records are its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic one.
